channel.description: Latest articles from The Highland Times (thehighlandtimes.com)

item.title: Graham Leadbitter Backs VAT Cut Campaign for Hospitality Sector
item.description: Moray West, Nairn and Strathspey MP Graham Leadbitter has backed a campaign calling for a VAT cut for hospitality businesses, arguing pubs, cafes and restaurants need support amid rising costs and squeezed incomes.The post Graham Leadbitter Backs VAT Cut Campaign for Hospitality Sector appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: ScotRail to Introduce £10 Minimum Fare to Tackle Ticketless Travel
item.description: ScotRail will introduce a £10 minimum fare from summer 2026 to tackle ticketless travel, aiming to reduce fare evasion which currently costs Scotland’s Railway more than £11 million each year.The post ScotRail to Introduce £10 Minimum Fare to Tackle Ticketless Travel appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: £272,000 Awarded to 12 Highland Projects in First Reuse and Repair Fund Round
item.description: Twelve community projects across the Highlands have secured more than £272,000 in the first round of The Highland Council’s Reuse and Repair Fund, supporting repair cafés, upcycling workshops and circular economy initiatives.The post £272,000 Awarded to 12 Highland Projects in First Reuse and Repair Fund Round appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Broadcasting Legend Talks of Returning to Scotland, but ‘Time is Running Out’
item.description: Radio presenter Ken Bruce has revealed he once dreamed of moving back to the Highlands and commuting to London on the Sleeper, as he spoke on the Scotland the Drive podcast about cars, buses and life after BBC Radio 2.The post Broadcasting Legend Talks of Returning to Scotland, but ‘Time is Running Out’ appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Labour Figures Attack SNP Energy Record as ‘Unjust Transition’ for Highlands Workers
item.description: Rhoda Grant and David Blair have criticised the Scottish Government’s energy transition record, claiming Highlands and Islands workers are being failed amid concerns over ScotWind, UHI Moray funding and North Sea job security.The post Labour Figures Attack SNP Energy Record as ‘Unjust Transition’ for Highlands Workers appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ariane Burgess Calls for Oversight After US Military Use of Highland Airports
item.description: Ariane Burgess has called for parliamentary oversight after Wick, Benbecula and Stornoway airports were used by US military aircraft during an operation linked to the oil tanker Marinera without prior Scottish Government knowledge.The post Ariane Burgess Calls for Oversight After US Military Use of Highland Airports appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Says New Poll Puts Majority and Independence ‘Within Touching Distance’
item.description: A new More in Common poll projects the SNP on 64 MSPs, one short of a Holyrood majority, with the party claiming independence is now within touching distance ahead of May’s election.The post SNP Says New Poll Puts Majority and Independence ‘Within Touching Distance’ appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Inverness Cocktail Week Returns With 50+ Venues and Citywide Deals
item.description: Inverness Cocktail Week returns from 20 February to 1 March 2026, with 50 venues offering £5 to £7 cocktails, signature drinks and exclusive deals across bars and restaurants in the city centre.The post Inverness Cocktail Week Returns With 50+ Venues and Citywide Deals appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Budget Pledges Investment for Highlands Public Services
item.description: The Scottish Budget includes £5 million for the Belford Hospital project, £10 million for ferry services and record funding for Highland and Moray councils, alongside a new bus fare cap pilot in the Highlands and Islands.The post Scottish Budget Pledges Investment for Highlands Public Services appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Rural Bungalow With Land and Sea Views in Tankerness
item.description: Set in Tankerness on Orkney Mainland, Gransetter offers a three bedroom bungalow within 9.6 acres, enjoying panoramic views over the Deer Sound and surrounding countryside, combining rural space with easy access to Kirkwall.The post A Rural Bungalow With Land and Sea Views in Tankerness appeared first on The Highland Times.
